Series V: Correspondence includes Andrea Callard's personal and administrative correspondence organized alphabetically by sender. The series is divided into four subseries. Subseries A contains correspondence from senders with known first and last names arranged alphabetically by last name. Subseries B includes correspondence from senders with known first names or first initials organized alphbetically. Subseries C contains correspondence from Andrea callard organized alphabetically by addressee. Subseries D includes unlabeld or illegible correspondence.
